articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 with Native Multimodal Reasoning and Extended Context
articles.summary: OpenAI officially launched GPT-5, featuring natively fused vision, audio, and text reasoning in a single architecture rather than bolted-on adapters. The model demonstrates significant improvements in long-horizon planning tasks and supports a 1M-token context window with near-linear attention scaling. Early benchmarks show a step-change in complex multi-step coding and scientific reasoning tasks.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Graduate-Level Science Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which surpasses previous frontier models on GPQA Diamond and a new suite of graduate-level STEM benchmarks. The model introduces a mixture-of-experts architecture with dynamic expert routing that reduces inference cost by roughly 40% compared to its predecessor. Google is integrating the model across Workspace, Cloud, and Android.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots in its Austin and Berlin factories for material handling and part inspection tasks. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and on-device vision-language models for task adaptation without cloud connectivity. Tesla claims the robots can learn new assembly sub-tasks from a few human demonstrations in under 30 minutes.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Workforce to Full Body-in-White Production Line
articles.summary: Figure AI announced the expansion of its humanoid robot deployment at BMW's Spartanburg plant, moving from a pilot of 50 units to over 200 robots operating across an entire body-in-white assembly line. The Figure 03 robots use a transformer-based whole-body control policy trained in simulation and fine-tuned with real-world teleoperation data. BMW reports a 15% throughput increase in the sections where the robots operate alongside human workers.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Claude Reasoning Traces' for Enterprise Auditability and Compliance
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new feature for Claude Enterprise that exposes structured chain-of-thought reasoning traces, allowing compliance teams to audit exactly how the model arrived at decisions in regulated workflows. The traces are logged in an append-only format compatible with SOC 2 and HIPAA audit frameworks. This addresses a long-standing barrier to LLM adoption in financial services and healthcare.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed it has started high-volume manufacturing on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node at its Kaohsiung fab, roughly one quarter ahead of the originally projected timeline. The node uses gate-all-around nanosheet transistors with backside power delivery, achieving a 20% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N2. Apple and Nvidia are reported to be among the first customers for chips shipping in early 2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation BCI Implant with 4,096 Electrodes
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink clearance to begin clinical trials for its N2 brain-computer interface, which quadruples electrode count to 4,096 channels and features a fully wireless design with on-chip spike sorting. The first cohort will focus on restoring motor control for spinal cord injury patients. Independent neuroscientists have noted the electrode density could enable significantly higher-bandwidth communication for paralyzed individuals.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: First Compliance Audits Target Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Office commenced its first formal compliance audits under the AI Act, targeting major foundation model providers including OpenAI, Google, and Meta regarding systemic risk assessments, red-teaming documentation, and energy consumption disclosures. Companies face fines of up to 3% of global revenue for non-compliance. The audits are being closely watched as a precedent for how prescriptive AI regulation will work in practice.
